channel.title: Vancouver Daily News
channel.description:
The morning brief for people who live in Metro Vancouver, ready before the commute. Every day: the civic and provincial stories that change something here, getting around (roads, transit and the forecast), sport, what is on, and one contested local issue argued fairly both ways. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — every story from named local sources.
